n: The psalmist calls the righteous to rejoice. Praise fits the upright naturally, like well-made clothing.
Praise is to be made with music — harps and stringed instruments. Worship in Israel was often musical and joyful.

f.g: A stringed instrument like a lyre or harp.

n: A “new song” celebrates fresh experiences of God’s goodness. The musicians are to play with skill and joyful shouts.

f.g: Shouts of joy, as at a festival.

n: Here is the reason for praise: what God says is upright, and everything he does is faithful and true.
God loves what is right and just, and the whole earth overflows with his loyal love.
God created the heavens and all their stars simply by speaking. His word is creative power.

f.w: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made

n: God piles up the sea like water gathered into a heap and stores the deep oceans like grain in a barn — a picture of complete control over nature.
Because God is the Creator, all people everywhere should reverence and stand in awe of him.
Creation was immediate: God spoke and it happened; he commanded and it held firm.

f.w: he spake, and it was done

n: Human nations make plans, but God can frustrate any scheme that opposes him.

f.w: bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought

f.g: The nations; peoples outside Israel’s covenant.

n: In contrast, God’s plans never fail. What he intends stands across all generations — a reminder of his eternal plan.

f.w: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever

n: Blessed is the nation that makes the Lord its God, and the people he chose as his own treasured inheritance.

f.w: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD

n: God looks down from heaven and sees every person — no one is overlooked.
From his dwelling place he watches over everyone living on earth.
God formed every human heart, so he understands every heart and notices every deed.

f.g: Forms, shapes as a potter does.

n: No king is saved by having a big army, and no warrior by his own strength. Real safety lies elsewhere.
Even the war horse — the ancient world’s most powerful military weapon — is a false hope for rescue.

f.w: An horse is a vain thing for safety

n: Instead, God’s eye is watching over those who reverence him and hope in his loyal love.
God watches over them to rescue them from death and keep them alive even in famine.
The community answers: we wait for the Lord, our help and shield.
Our hearts rejoice in him because we trust his holy name — his revealed character.
The closing prayer: may your loyal love rest on us, in the same measure as our hope in you.

f.w: according as we hope in thee
f.g: Just as, or because, we put our hope in you.
